% ybar stacked with positive and negative values (separate sums), painted
% last plot first. Behaviour U6.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ybar stacked, bar width=12pt]
  \addplot coordinates {(1,2) (2,-1) (3,1) (4,2)};
  \addplot coordinates {(1,1) (2,-2) (3,-3) (4,1)};
  \addplot coordinates {(1,0.5) (2,1) (3,2) (4,-1)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
